newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong's new crude unit goes commercial.
newsitem.headline: Yukong's new crude unit goes commercial.

text.p: Yukong Ltd, South Korea's largest oil refiner, said on Tuesday it had begun commercial production of its new 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) over the weekend.
"We are now running the topper at 90 percent capacity," said a Yukong official. "We plan to have the unit running at full capacity by Friday."
Yukong started feeding crude oil to the unit early last month, he said.
The new CDU will raise Yukong's total refining capacity to 810,000 bpd.
With the new unit running near full capacity, Yukong closed down its 265,000 bpd CDU on Tuesday for annual maintenance, he said.
The official said the CDU is planned to resume operation on November 14.
